200 rs extra is charged if you have a laptop that you want to plug in.
There are limited sinks per floor and some of those are not working either.
Cleaning is done entirely by renters, no sort of cleaning is provided for.
The wardens are rude when approached about these things.
There are mandatory prayers every evening and sometimes, a mandatory attendance meeting where a preacher preaches.
Overall, there is a lot of hypocrisy and restrictions.
